auditor: Independent Scientific Data and Evaluation Auditor

historical_production_annotations.status: No historical dual-reviewer ground-truth annotations exist in the production database. Previous simulated annotations were ephemeral test fixtures.

governance_audit.vulnerability_prior_state: The previous POST /api/recordings/{id}/annotations accepted an arbitrary client-supplied reviewer_id string without verifying independent identity or account separation, allowing a single user to forge consensus.

inter_rater_reliability_framework.disagreement_visibility: Disagreements are explicitly labeled as 'disputed' and individual reviewer decisions are preserved.

recommended_protocol_for_ground_truth.independence_requirement: Reviewers must access the system from distinct authenticated accounts with no access to system predictions or peer annotations prior to submission.
recommended_protocol_for_ground_truth.qualification: Certified veterinary behaviorists or animal ethologists with demonstrated inter-rater kappa >= 0.75 on calibration sets.
